correctness.rationale: Character orthogonality over R² identifies the fourth moment with squared pair-sum fiber sums. For odd p, mixed mod-p residue classes have exactly a swapped ordered pair, contributing 4 m_r m_s per unordered class pair; same-residue fibers reduce to additive convolution on F_p. Parseval gives ∑|f_r*f_r|²=(1/p)∑|fhat_r|⁴ and ∑|fhat_r|²=p m_r, proving the displayed nonnegative identity for every complex f. Strict defects imply one residue packet and a single Fourier frequency. For unit inputs, mixed defect ≥(p−2)(1−∑m_r²), and the best Fourier-packet projection proves dist²≤(p−1)/(p−2)δ. Exact pair-fiber consistency program from matching Git blob 43466d... was run: VERIFY_OK cases=107 over p=3,5,7, with four Fourier synthesis tests; those finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
